newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 4.80 million barrels in the week ended August 15 to 316.17 million barrels from a revised 311.37 million barrels that was previously reported as 312.16 million the previous week, the American Petroleum Institute said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.60 million barrels in the week to 256.01 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.46 million barrels to 123.21 million barrels from 120.75 million barrels the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 891,000 barrels to 50.67 million barrels.
API said gasoline production fell 38,000 barrels per day in the week to 7.88 million bpd from 7.92 million bpd in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks fell 3.27 million barrels in the week to 187.79 million barrels from 191.06 million.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 97.5 percent from 95.0 percent the prior week.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 73,000 barrels to 37.24 million barrels from 37.31 million barrels the previous week.
API also said refinery operating rate excluding PADD 5 fell to 100.3 percent in the week from 103.5 percent the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 15.07 million barrels per day from 14.68 million the previous week.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 36.84 million barrels from 36.43 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 8.90 million barrels per day from 9.00 million, API said.
